data.content_ref: inline:The 'Systemic Blind Spot' mechanism reduces SRC_004 to a subset of SRC_005, arguing that 'knowledge errors' are actually just failures in the implicit weighting of information. A non-expert panel doesn't just miss a step; they lack the 'pivot variable' detection. This is refuted if a panel of non-experts can correctly identify the 'pivot' variable through purely additive checklist logic.
